Method of Attack: Bypassing security mechanisms in applications through incorrect parsing of email addresses in the email module.
Impacted Systems: Applications relying on email verification for domain-specific access control.
Attack Vector: Specially crafted email addresses with special characters.

Method of Attack: Regular Expression Denial of Service (ReDoS) through excessive backtracking in tarfile.TarFile header parsing.
Impacted Systems: Systems processing maliciously crafted tar archives.

Method of Attack: Header injection attacks through improper quoting of newlines in email headers during serialization.
Impacted Systems: Email systems using CPython’s email module for message serialization.

Method of Attack: Denial of Service (DoS) through quadratic complexity in parsing cookies with backslashes in quoted values.
Impacted Systems: Systems using CPython’s http.cookies module for cookie parsing.

Method of Attack: Denial of Service (DoS) through infinite loops when iterating over entry names in maliciously crafted zip archives.
Impacted Systems: Systems using CPython’s zipfile.Path class for metadata reading or content extraction.
